climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A wine area in Burgenland, Austria, whose DAC wine is made only from Blaufränkisch. The grape covers 52 percent of its vineyards, with Zweigelt second at 24 percent.
